nodes.label: ft_transcendence Subject (v21.1)
nodes.rationale: Final Common Core group project (4-5 people): mandatory core every member contributes to plus chosen modules counting toward the grade.

nodes.label: AI Instructions (Chapter I)
nodes.rationale: Use AI only for content you fully understand and can take responsibility for; always seek peer review, because in evaluation you must explain your code.

nodes.label: Required Team Roles
nodes.rationale: Clear roles from the start; with 4 people one member may hold several roles. All roles must be documented in README.md.

nodes.label: Recommended Project Management Practices
nodes.rationale: Not mandatory: regular meetings, task tracking (GitHub Issues/Trello), work breakdown, code reviews, documentation, chat channel. Team must explain role distribution and coordination at evaluation.

nodes.label: Mandatory Part (Chapter III)
nodes.rationale: Project content is chosen by the team; README.md must be created first.

nodes.label: General Requirements (III.2)
nodes.rationale: Failing any general requirement rejects the project.

nodes.label: Web App with Frontend, Backend and Database
Git Commits from All Members with Clear Messages
Containerized Deployment Run with a Single Command
No Warnings or Errors in Browser Console
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service Pages
nodes.rationale: Verified at evaluation; must be reachable (e.g. footer links) with real content, not placeholders, or the project is rejected.

nodes.label: Multi-user Support (Mandatory)
nodes.rationale: Concurrent users without conflicts: simultaneous sessions, concurrent actions handled, real-time updates where applicable, no data corruption or race conditions.

nodes.label: Database with Clear Schema and Relations
Form Validation in Frontend and Backend
HTTPS for All Backend Connections
nodes.rationale: Any browser/script/external connection to the backend must use HTTPS; internal backend traffic may be unencrypted.

nodes.label: Framework Definition
nodes.rationale: A framework gives structured architecture, built-in features and an ecosystem; React counts as a framework, jQuery/Lodash/Axios do not.

nodes.label: 14-Point Module Requirement (Major=2, Minor=1)
nodes.rationale: Aiming above 14 points is advised since some modules may not be validated at evaluation.

nodes.label: Module Dependencies and Evaluation Rules
nodes.rationale: Only fully functional modules count; non-functional or incomplete modules score 0 points.

nodes.label: Major: Framework for Frontend and Backend
Major: Public API with API Key, Rate Limiting, Docs
Major: Standard User Management and Authentication
Minor: Game Statistics and Match History
Major: Another Game with History and Matchmaking
Minor: Gamification System
nodes.rationale: Minor but substantial: three well-implemented features beat six poor ones.

nodes.label: Major: Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana
Minor: Health Check, Status Page, Backups, Disaster Recovery
Modules of Choice (IV.10)
nodes.rationale: Custom module must be substantial and justified in README (why chosen, challenges, value, why Major); trivial features are rejected.

nodes.label: Project Ideas and Examples (Chapter V)
nodes.rationale: Suggestions only; pick a project the team is motivated by, that reaches 14 points with coherent module combinations and fits the timeline.

nodes.label: Example: Building a Pong Game (14 points)
README Requirements (Chapter VI)
nodes.rationale: README is a critical part of evaluation; must be clear, complete, professional, honest, in English.

nodes.label: README Resources Section with AI Usage Description
README Team Information and Individual Contributions
README Modules Section with Point Calculation and Justification
Bonus Part (Chapter VII, max 5 points)
nodes.rationale: Considered only if the 14 mandatory points are met; each extra module must be functional, meet requirements, add value and be justified in README.

nodes.label: Submission and Peer-evaluation (Chapter VIII)
nodes.rationale: Only repository content is evaluated; a brief live modification may be requested to verify actual understanding.
